reviews.text: We are new to the Area & brought our two dogs in for routine care. They are all so kind and gentle with our dogs. By far one of the best Vet Clinics we have ever been to. They are so patient and help our high anxiety Shephard feel comfortable.

First time here and we came because Licha’s favorite Vet, Dr Tyler works here. She is the most fantastic Vet on the planet imo. Caring and loving with my Licha, she always takes the time to find out exactly what’s going on with her and the best plan of action. I always feel that she has Licha’s best health in mind and they aren’t just throwing meds at her. This office is a considerable drive from our house but we would do it daily if we had to just to see Dr Tyler.

I’ve been bringing my two dogs here for over a year, and both veterinarians and the whole staff are amazing. We would have lost our oldest dog over six months ago if it weren’t for TVC. They are compassionate, caring, and provide excellent service.
Vets know how to handle scared anxious dogs.  Very kind, hands on.

Thank you for the wonderful care you gave Bentley.  Your kindness, thoughtfulness, and gentle professional manner made the situation be one that I remember with a gentle smile, a tear and a tug on my heart.

We were referred here by a friend, so we’ve been bringing our dog here for years now and we love it!  The Docs are the best and the staff is super friendly and knowledgeable.  You can tell everyone really cares about the animals, and they do so much to make your fur family feel welcome and comfortable.  Truly the best experience!

I cannot say enough about this practice. One of my dogs was having some issues and my regular vet had no appointments so I made an appointment with Tierrasanta Veterinary Hospital. My dog ended up unexpectedly passing away just prior to my appointment so I called to cancel the appointment. The receptionist said that I could bring my dog in to be cremated, and I explained that my husband is currently deployed and I am unable to move a 80-90 lb dog on my own. To my amazement, the receptionist told me that personnel (angels in my opinion) from Tierrasanta Veterinary Hospital would come to my house to assist. They did and I am so eternally grateful. I was in shock to find my dog deceased and at a total loss of how to remove him from my house. The women who came were so kind and compassionate. They made a horrible experience the best as possible. I will be giving all of my future vet business to this practice and recommend you do as well as this is a practice that is clearly willing to go above and beyond for its clients. Thank you so much, Tierrasanta Veterinary Hospital, and especially the two women who came to my house (I apologize for not even catching your names at the time but I was still in a bit of shock). Please know I will forever appreciate your extreme act of kindness.

After calling around in San Diego!! Had bad experience at ABC hospital in Pacific Beach !  I Found Tierrasanta veterinary hospital!! Very professional ! Caring staff and Vet dr Tyler !! Was very caring awesome service!! I am super Happy for there Help international Health certificate!! Very Happy!!
All employees are incredibly knowledgeable and helpful, compassionate and caring. Vet is personable and takes care of her patients and patients humans as much as possible! I give them 5 stars.
They are wonderful with our 14yo maltipoo. They always treat him with care and concern.
Clean facility with friendly, professional staff
Michelle and her team are wonderful and treated my little guy with compassion. They made him feel right at home during our visit. 10/10, Highly recommend 👍🏽 …
Everyone was Very Friendly and helpful. We will be going back in 2 weeks.
Dr. Schexneider and staff are the best! They practice Fear Free methods, reasonably priced, and they truly care for your fur babies.

I found TS veterinary hospital during my search for animal export papers needed to travel with my service dog. The entire office is friendly, professional and helpful.
Highly recommended if traveling or looking for a less corporate more family type vet.

Thank you.. Tierrasanta veterinary hospital!

Always a good experience and you can come here to get your passport documentation for your dog. Came here for Hawaii, Greece,and France :) good yearly physicals and they now offer grooming which we have not used yet.

I’ve been bringing my dog here since I got her 6 years ago. When we went to college together, I’d travel back home to take her to this vet because I love them so much! It is so obvious how much the whole staff loves animals. I know my dog is very well loved when she’s in their hands! I will always choose Tierrasanta Vet. Maya and I love you Dr. S + team!!!!
Glad we could provide you with an enjoyable, compassionate visit.

Love this place! TVH is Fear Free certified & truly practices what they preach. My dog has been terrified of the vet her whole life, 14 years. But not here! They work with you & your pet to make it as stress-free as possible for everyone. Highly recommend!

The staff here was really great. We ended up having to put our dog down, but they went out of their way to give us all of our options and were with us until the very end. They even contacted us after the fact with a sympathy card. It would have been a lot harder of a situation if we weren't in such good hands.

** 1 year update **

This is still the best veterinary clinic we have been too. We bring our cats and they are always so gentle with them (even if my cats aren't the most enthused lol). They even have pheromone blankets to put on their carriers to help calm them down. My cats are always happy (or the happiest they can be) to be here. The vet also helps find cost effective alternatives for medication. 1000/10 recommend this place.

I called to issue an international health certificate and export permit for my dog, but since my dog ​​will be traveling with an international pet transportation company, they refused to do so. We urgently needed to issue the documents and explained everything to them, but they simply said that if the dog is not traveling with its family, even if everything is properly authorized, they will not provide the service, on the grounds that they have had problems with pet companies in the past.

We have taken our kitties to Terrasanta Veterinary hospital for years. They are Fear Free Certified veterinary professionals. The staff has always been gentle, caring and attentive to our kitties. We recommend them to anyone who wants loving care for their pets.

I recently took my dog Sky to his first vet appointment since we adopted him from the humane society, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience. The staff at the vet clinic were so welcoming and friendly, making Sky feel comfortable and …

TVH is amazing - when I walked into the office it had a very calming spa effect on me. I love that I was able to put on a calming bandana on my puppy for his first appointment. The staff is great and so is Dr. Schexnieder!! I'm so happy I found TVH.
An amazing veterinarian. Great staff. Rate prices very military friendly
